toc_plan.st: Where to start, week by week

setup_intro: A Claude that knows nothing about your brand or your clients gives you generic answers. Before you use a single prompt from this guide, give it your context once. After that, every conversation starts from there.

setup_steps.d: A Project groups your conversations, files and instructions. Everything you put in it is read in every new conversation of the Project.

setup_steps.t: Write your brand sheet with Claude
setup_steps.d: Run prompt 1 on the right. Claude asks its questions, then writes the sheet. Save it and add it to the Project files.
Copy prompt 2 into the Project instructions. Also add your best posts, your sales page and a few client reviews.

setup_prompts.title: Prompt 1 · Your brand sheet
setup_prompts.use: Run it once, inside the Project
setup_prompts.prompt: You are a marketing director. Help me write the brand sheet for [YOUR BUSINESS NAME]. Ask me your questions one at a time (10 at most): what I sell, to whom, the problem I solve, my prices, my competitors, what makes me different, my tone, the words I refuse to use, my channels, my goal for the next 90 days. Wait for my answer before each new question. At the end, write a one-page sheet with clear headings, in a document I can download.

setup_prompts.title: Prompt 2 · The Project instructions
setup_prompts.use: Paste it into the Project instructions
setup_prompts.prompt: You are my marketing team. Before every answer, rely on the brand sheet and the Project files. Write in English, address the reader as “you”, use short sentences and no jargon. Never invent a number, a client review or a result: if information is missing, ask for it or write [MISSING INFO]. When I ask for a deliverable, first suggest a short outline, then produce the final version. Always point out what you assumed.

features_title: THE FEATURES USED IN THIS GUIDE

features.d: your context (instructions and files) shared by every conversation.
documents, tables and pages created next to the conversation, to edit and download.
Claude looks for recent sources and cites them.
reusable instructions Claude loads on its own when the task matches.
Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, HubSpot, Slack… to work on your real data.

plan_intro: You don't have to do everything. One week, one block, a few actions. By the end of the month, Claude knows your brand, your content ships every week and you read your numbers without losing your Sunday.

actions: Create the “Marketing” Project and brand sheet
Describe your ideal client on one page
Update your bio and your sales page
Add a clear FAQ to your main page
Run 1 A/B test with a single hypothesis
Turn your weekly report into a Skill

end_paras: This guide does not replace your judgment. Claude writes fast, analyzes fast and never gets tired. You know your clients, you decide and you check.
Start with page 03. Set up your Project. Then pick a single chapter this week and apply it all the way.
The rest will come faster than you think.
